name: Sentinel
description: Sentinel watches Jellyfin playback sessions and explains, with evidence, why a specific transcode or playback problem happened — not just that it happened.
overview: Evidence-based root-cause diagnosis for Jellyfin playback problems

versions.changelog: Fixes a confirmed bug in 0.1.0.0: installing on a real Jellyfin server resulted in status 'Malfunctioned' because of native SQLite library loading (see build.yaml changelog for the full root cause). This fix is verified by code inspection and a clean local build/test run, but not yet re-confirmed on a real server. 0.1.0.0 is removed from this list since it is confirmed broken.
